Runtime: DLSS %s | DLSS-NR %s | DLSS Frame Generation %s | Reflex %s
Selects the preferred temporal upscaler. DLSS falls back to FSR when unavailable.
Controls NVIDIA Image Scaling sharpen for DLSS and RCAS for FSR.
DLSS Frame Generation is unavailable with R16G16B16A16_FLOAT (FP16, format 10) swapchain output.

When RenoDX or another color-format modification uses R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, FidelityFX Frame Generation is used instead when FG is enabled. DLSS upscaling remains available. DLSS multi-frame and Dynamic MFG settings do not apply.
Uses DLSS Frame Generation when available, otherwise FidelityFX Frame Generation (including FP16 output).
Controls the requested DLSS generated-frame multiplier. The runtime clamps unsupported values.
Controls NVIDIA Reflex low-latency mode. Frame generation forces at least On while active.
D3D12 output VSync, including FG. On disables DLSS-G if its runtime does not support VSync. Driver overrides still apply.

Reflex-independent frame-start pacing for D3D12 output. 0 disables; values below 10 become 10. Includes FG. Dynamic MFG uses its maximum multiplier conservatively and may run below the target. A cap alone does not prevent tearing; use VSync/VRR.
Runs experimental DLSS-NR at the selected stage. NR failure preserves the SR path.
Runs up to three independent direct-NGX NR histories. Streamline-native NR remains single-pass.
Lets DLSS-NR infer its own screen-space control mask when no application mask is supplied.
Shows D3D12 swapchain and upscaler status while DLSS or FSR is active.
